It's the day before Pochacco's birthday and he's skateboarding around looking for his friends. He hopes to have a grand party with them the next day, but they all seem busy!

The central character is a 7 year old girl called Sachiko. She has just lost her immediate family in the firebombing of Tokyo and takes the train to her uncle’s family in Kumagaya in Saitama Prefecture. She is not out of danger yet, for the train gets shot at by a plane along the journey. Her uncle meets her at the station and he and his whole family welcome her with open arms. With her cousins, Sachiko explores the beauty of the natural landscape around Kumagaya.

Sadly, these beautiful days of late summer are not to last. The final movement of the film depicts the final air raid of the war. The city descends into fear and chaos and Sachiko gets separated from her family with tragic results.

(Source: Nishikataeiga)

Three-part series about Hangyodon and friend's time travel adventures.

This entry contains:
1.Kyouryuu Oukoku wa Oosawagi (恐竜王国は大さわぎ)
Hangyodon and company end up getting sent back to the past through Itaro's latest Time Closet invention and have themselves a prehistoric adventure!

2.Mirai Sekai wa Oosawagi (未来世界は大さわぎ)
Hangyodon and his friends travel into the futuristic 25th century in order to stop Xian Long Bao and save Princess Kingyochan as well as her father, the emperor Chuuka Taijin. The gang might also run into a familiar face or two....

3.Hana no Oedo wa Oosawagi (花のお江戸は大さわぎ)
Hangyodon, Sayuri, and Otamaro are tasked with going back in time to the Edo period at the insistence of rich old Sea-Otter and his ghostly ancestor to retrieve their golden Kannon statue heirloom. Once in the Edo period, Hangyodon and his friends learn of the Full-Moon Kozou, a thief said to soon steal the statue on the next full moon which is rapidly approaching... But just who is the real identity of this notorious thief? What does Kingyo-chan's Edo ancestor have to do with all of this? And will Hangyodon manage to retrieve the heirloom in one piece?

title.romaji: Eddy & Emmy no Initial Ring wa Futari de

media.description:
As Eddy and Emmy's birthday is coming up, the two friends find themselves faced with dilemmas that threaten to put a damper on the special occasion; Emmy is chosen to perform with Cal, one of the most popular boys for the school festival and is busy with the auditions that come with it, while Eddy feels left out in all of the excitement.

Will they find a way to pull through, or will the duo be forced to also give up their prized rings in the process?

title.romaji: Mary Bell no Hi no Youjin: Guratto Kitara Dousuru

media.description: A fire safety short starring the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell cast. It specifically focuses on fires that start because of an earthquake and what a child should do in such a situation when they may be trapped in a building. The short was re-released on the Hana no Mahoutsukai Mary Bell DVD-Box Set in 2009.
